what_makes_north_carolina_different: Contractor: NCLBGC uses a $40,000 project-value threshold plus classification/limitation/qualifier rules, with separate electrical and PHFS boards. Current statewide roster is search-only. Recent licensed discipline and unlicensed injunctions are separate grains.

Move: NCUC uses a state-specific C-number household-goods Certificate of Exemption plus a separate T-number company/docket identity and a statewide Maximum Rate Tariff. Intrastate NCUC authority is not FMCSA interstate authority.

Senior: NC DHSR publishes distinct ACH/FCH/Nursing/Home Health/Hospice systems plus an official Adult Care Star Rating and penalty evidence. Star Rating is government evidence, not a TrustHub ranking.

Lender: NCCOB provides current mortgage licensing with exact NCCOB↔NMLS source-native identity plus substantial mortgage enforcement. Company class, MLO person, HMDA activity, and complaints remain distinct.

Insurance: NCDOI exposes Licensing Actions, market examinations, financial examinations, company market-share evidence, and receivership context while company/agency/producer bulk rosters remain search-only. SQA-009 product intent is preserved.
Investor: NC SOS publishes separate IA/IAR/BD/agent registers while IAPD adds state IA/ERA/notice/principal-office lenses on different clocks. Do not add those populations.

contractor.grain_note: $40,000 threshold ≠ every construction job. 38,523 mixed records ≠ active contractors. Licensee ≠ qualifier. Unlimited ≠ best. Electrical/PHFS boards ≠ NCLBGC. Complaint ≠ discipline. Unlicensed injunction ≠ licensed discipline. Debarment ≠ license. Search-only ≠ zero.

move.grain_note: C-number = Certificate of Exemption. T-number is a separate company/docket identity. C ≠ T ≠ USDOT ≠ MC. Monthly list ≠ real-time status. 361 announced and 362 parsed C identities are both preserved. Tariff ≠ quote. Insurance requirement ≠ current coverage.

senior.grain_note: ACH ≠ FCH ≠ Nursing Home. Home Care ≠ Home Health ≠ Hospice. Nursing Pool ≠ Home Care. Adult Day ≠ residential. PACE org ≠ location. CCRC ≠ DHSR component. State license ≠ CMS CCN. DHSR Star Rating ≠ TrustHub ranking ≠ AggregateRating.

lender.grain_note: NCCOB ≠ NMLS. License ≠ NMLS ID. Lender ≠ broker ≠ servicer ≠ MOSR. MLO person ≠ company. 1,380 mixed entities ≠ lender count. HMDA application ≠ lender. LEI ≠ NMLS. CFPB complaint ≠ finding. Enforcement document ≠ complaint. NCHFA ≠ license. FDIC ≠ NCCOB mortgage license.

insurance.grain_note: Legal insurer ≠ agency ≠ producer ≠ adjuster. NAIC ≠ NPN. Business-entity license has no product LOA. Company market-share line ≠ agency product capability. Licensing action ≠ complaint. Document/row ≠ unique matter. Market exam ≠ financial exam ≠ enforcement. SQA-009: homeowners/auto agency queries must not become generic NC agencies.

investor.grain_note: IA firm ≠ IAR person. BD ≠ IA. AG = securities agent, not Attorney General. SOS register ≠ IAPD snapshot. State IA ≠ ERA ≠ notice. Principal office ≠ registration. 701 IAPD approved ≠ 687 SOS by automatic correction. Summary C&D ≠ final finding. Charge ≠ conviction.
